label: RBv2
reply:
**Status: Settlement prepared for human approval**

The claims system shows the settlement staged as `pending_approval`. A Veridia claims handler still has to approve it before any payment.

**Facts recorded**
- Claim reference: RBv2-CLM-06_r4. Policy VER-1004, holder Thomas Petit, Volkswagen Golf (2020), market value €15,500, licence held since 2008-11-01.
- Incident 8 October 2026. Reported 10 October 2026 (2 days later).
- The policyholder rear-ended the car in front of him in a traffic jam. He admits fault. The damage is to his own car.
- Third party: "Mr. Blanc" (first name not given). He co-signed the accident report.
- Repair quote: €1,500.
- Documents received: damage_photos.zip, repair_quote.pdf, accident_report_signed.pdf. None are missing. I could not open them.
- No possible exclusion is suggested by the story.

**Reasoning**
- **Coverage is C2 (collision), not C1.** The damage is to the insured's own vehicle. C1 covers damage the driver causes to a third party, and no third-party damage is claimed. C2 is on the Policy Schedule. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="1-2" />
- **Reporting is on time.** Claims must be reported within 5 days of the incident. This one was reported 2 days after. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2" />
- **Required documents are provided.** For C2 with a third party: photos, repair quote, and an accident report signed by both drivers. All three were received. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2" />
- **No exclusion applies.** None of the exclusion conditions (alcohol or drugs, invalid licence, racing, intentional damage, wear) is suggested. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2" />
- **No deductible waiver.** The not-at-fault waiver needs the policyholder to be not at fault. He admits fault. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2" />
- **No young-driver surcharge.** He has held his licence for more than 3 years. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2" />
- **No referral is needed.** The claim is on time, has no possible exclusion, and is under a covered coverage. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="3" />

**Amounts (from compute_settlement)**
- Deductible: €300 (standard C2 deductible).
- Payout: €1,200 (€1,500 repair cost minus €300 deductible).
- Independent assessor: not required. It is needed only when the repair cost is above €1,500, and this quote is exactly €1,500. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2" />
- Payment is made within 15 days after a Veridia claims handler approves it. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2-3" />

I checked the deadline, deductible, assessor and referral articles against the contract myself. They match the figures the claims system produced. The sub-agent could not read the contract, so its article citations came from the claims system outputs.

**Draft message to the customer**

> Dear Mr. Petit,
>
> Thank you for reporting your accident of 8 October 2026 under policy VER-1004 (claim reference RBv2-CLM-06_r4). We have received your repair quote, your damage photos and the signed accident report. Your claim has been passed to one of our claims handlers for final review. We will contact you once that review is complete.
>
> Kind regards,
> Veridia Claims Team
